answer: Agents relaying a sonnet to orchard speakers face a proposed daily audit horizon: each ID must deliver 1 GB of nonce-bound unicast probe traffic. Trusted receivers meter wire bytes and sign ID/day totals; validators deny listing for missing, reused or sub-quota receipts. Bandwidth is recurring load; routers are reusable capital; no stake. Colluding receivers can fake counts, and spare capacity makes IDs cheap; ownership is unproved. Ten IDs require 10 GB/day even on shared links or in parallel; no byte is credited twice.
